name: Chokethorn

abilities.name: Piercing Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Pulling Grasp
abilities.description: The boss pulls in players that are far away, stunning them briefly.

abilities.name: Fungal Burst
abilities.description: The boss releases a burst of poison around itself as indicated by a large red circle. This attack deals high poison damage and should be blocked or avoided.

abilities.name: Summon Strangler Saplings
abilities.description: The boss summons saplings that will heal it over time. They should be interrupted or killed quickly to prevent this.

related_quests: Ancient Remains: Investigate Wood Orc activity in the ruins beneath Elden Root.
Pledge: Elden Hollow I: Explore Elden Hollow I and return Undaunted.
summary: This article is about the strangler found in Elden Hollow I. For the set, see Chokethorn (set). Chokethorn is a gigantic strangler found in Elden Hollow I, of which it is a boss. Its unique loot is Chokethorn's Healing Root. It must be defeated in order to unseal Canonreeve Oraneth's room.
